title: Integral Ind lower-tail vanishing
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite intermediate extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in its fixed algebraic closure, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $X$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $R_X=p_X^*\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ [def-sfb-padic-integers-condensed-ring; sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}_{R_X}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and $H=\operatorname{Cons}(X,\mathcal O_E)$, defined by finite constant models on constructible strata [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Work in the ordinary unbounded category $D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and the fixed small universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Write $H^{\mathrm{ind}}$ for objects isomorphic to small filtered colimits of objects of $H$, and $P$ for complexes all of whose cohomology sheaves lie in $H^{\mathrm{ind}}$. For each $C\in H$ fix $d_C\in\mathbf N$ such that $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(C[0],N[0][q])=0$ for all $N\in H$ and all integers $q>d_C$. Then every $L\in P$ with $L\in D^{\le-d_C-1}(\mathcal A)$ satisfies $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(C[0],L)=0$. No lower bound on $L$ is required.

proof.text: Apply the integral degree-zero-complex filtered comparison from integral_single_preserves_filtered in IntegralIndHeartRealization in shift -n. The single-functor shift isomorphism identifies it with Hom from C into singleFunctor at degree n. A representative of the inverse image of any map in the filtered colimit gives factorization through one stage. This is exactly DerivedCategory.HomFactorsThroughFilteredColimits for the integral source.

source.place: Paragraph (2), extension of the uniform bound to IndCons

proof.text: Set N=-d_C-1. The given Ext bound and the single-functor shift isomorphism imply zero Hom into every constructible sheaf placed in a degree n at most N. The coefficient-independent source-library lemma eq_zero_of_ind extends this vanishing to filtered colimits by the factorization from step 1. This uses the generic proof, not the rational coefficient specialization.

Use the internal-module/sectionwise-module equivalence for the actual integral coefficient sheaf. Apply products_exact to its section-ring sheaf and the countable indexing set, explicitly fixing the module universe to u+1. Transport limits and exactness of countable products across the equivalence. Grothendieckness gives K-injective resolutions. The general source-library DerivedCategory.eq_zero_of_isLE applies: bounded truncation induction gives vanishing on each tower term and on its degree-minus-one shift, and the proved homotopy-limit/left-completeness API gives zero Hom on a tail supported in degrees at most N-1.

Use the truncation triangle at N to separate L into its part at most N-1 and its single layer in degree N. The first receives no maps by step 3; the single layer receives no maps by eq_zero_of_isGE_of_isLE_self and step 2. Exactness of Hom into the triangle factors every map through the first term and hence makes it zero. This recovers the exact endpoint at most -d_C-1 without weakening the statement.

proof_origin.place: Paragraph (2), continuity plus the general CompactOfBoundedExt lower-tail proof, exact countable pro-etale products transported to internal modules, followed by the endpoint truncation triangle. No new unproved statement.

theorem integralIndLowerTail
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p) (hpℓ : p ≠ ℓ)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (d : ConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X → ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ (C N : ConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X)
      (q : ℤ), (d C : ℤ) < q →
        Subsingleton (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj C.obj) ⟶
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N.obj)⟦q⟧)) :
    let A := Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X)
    let H : ObjectProperty A := IsConstantModelConstructible
      (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X
    ∀ (C : H.FullSubcategory) (L : DerivedCategory A),
      DerivedCategory.homologyProperty H.ind.{u + 1} L →
      L.IsLE (-(d C : ℤ) - 1) →
      Subsingleton (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj C.obj) ⟶ L)
